project_type: Go backend (REST API with go-chi) + Angular v22 frontend (SPA)
build_command: make build && cd ui && pnpm run build
test_command: make test && cd ui && pnpm exec ng test --watch=false
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'make build' to compile Go. 2. Run 'make test' for Go unit tests. 3. Run 'cd ui && pnpm exec ng test --watch=false' for UI tests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ui/src/locale/messages.ja.xlf is generated by 'cd ui && npx ng extract-i18n' then manually edited for Japanese translations
setup_instructions: Go 1.26.5 via asdf. UI: pnpm install in ui/. Build: make build.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. No Docker daemon needed for tests. Integration tests need PostgreSQL but unit tests do not.
contribution_requirements: All i18n text needs @@ custom IDs. Angular standalone components (no explicit standalone:true). Signals for state. TailwindCSS v4 for styling. OnPush is default in Angular v22+. Use pnpm exec not npx for Angular CLI.
key_patterns: Backend: internal/cvss/cvss.go has BaseScore(vector) -> (float64, bool). internal/model/summary.go has normalizeCVSSScore() for score->severity level, SeverityLevelName() for level->label. Store pattern: PostgresStore methods build responses from DB queries. Frontend: inline templates, signals, native control flow (@if, @for), i18n with @@ IDs.
directory_structure: cmd/mayu/ (CLI entrypoint), internal/ (Go packages: cvss, model, server, store), ui/src/app/ (Angular app: models, services, pages, shared), migrations/ (SQL)
